newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian official says EU integrationists down to 4.
newsitem.headline: Belgian official says EU integrationists down to 4.

text.p: Belgium's chief European Union treaty negotiator said on Friday he believed the Amsterdam EU Summit had demonstrated that countries pushing for a more federal Europe were now in the minority in the 15-nation bloc.

"Those countries which have a truly integrationist project for Europe are now in a minority. At Amsterdam we saw that there were only four which were really pushing for it: Belgium, Italy, Austria and Finland. The Franco-German motor was derailed," Franklin Dehousse told Belgian RTBF television.
Dehousse said a majority of EU nations seemed to be pushing for enlargement before reforming the bloc's institutions, a subject that was skirted by EU leaders at Amsterdam.
Belgium believed EU institutions should be reformed before enlargement could take place, he said.
